test_title: PYST 9: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 6 & 3 * # 2 @ 4 # 1 & 8 £ Ω 5 * $ 7 % 9 (Right)

How many such symbols are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number but NOT immediately followed by an even number?
solution:
Given: (Left) 6 & 3 * # 2 @ 4 # 1 & 8 £ Ω 5 * $ 7 % 9 (Right)

Now, 

Symbols are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number but NOT immediately followed by an even number

So, Needed pattern is: Odd Number (O)⇒Symbol (S) ⇒ NOT Even Number.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f694015e43153ac0df5a0d079d472e70d3307eef5970e78c832d67f7b37b4ef0.png] 

There are three such symbols: **(3 * #), (5 * $), and (7 % 9)**, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number but not immediately followed by an even number.

Hence, the correct answer is* 'Option 3'.*
